stories.headline: A.J. Brown goes down in New England, and the whole camp shifts
stories.read: Doc's heard it straight off the wire: Brown took a high-ankle spill in his Patriots debut against Seattle and an MRI confirmed he's laid up at least four weeks, maybe longer. That's a bell-cow receiver ridin' the bench, pardner, and every other Pats pass-catcher just got a bigger cut of the throws. Go pan that creek on Stefon Diggs and whoever's runnin' the slot before the rest of the saloon catches on.

stories.headline: Brock Bowers gets his knee cleaned out, and Michael Mayer strikes gold
stories.read: The Raiders' star tight end went under the knife for a meniscus trim and is nursin' a busted wing for at least a game or two. That leaves Michael Mayer holdin' the reins as the starter, and tight end is thin range to begin with, so this ain't no rock, it's a vein. If Mayer's sittin' on the open range in your outfit, stake your claim today, not after he goes off Sunday.

stories.headline: Sam Darnold's hip holds him out, and Drew Lock saddles up in Seattle
stories.read: Darnold took a hit in Wednesday's tilt and while the doc's news is good, no fracture, just a muscle strain, he's still expected to miss the Week 2 showdown against Arizona. Drew Lock rides in behind him, and that's a horse you rent for one ride at best, not one you trust with your season. Seahawks pass-catchers take a mild hit in the floor department 'til Darnold's back in the saddle.
